open_points.subject: Run advancement of flow constants (A13 vs M16)
open_points.text: A13 defines start-time delivery for flow inputs ("At start, each flow input's value is delivered...") but gives no equivalent step for FlowConstants, while M16 says a constant is "delivered to one input port like any other value."
open_points.question: When, in run advancement, are flow constants materialized and validated for node readiness (e.g., at run start, lazily when node selected, or another point)?
options: Inject all constants at run start before ready-node selection
Inject constant only when its target node is evaluated
Treat constants as pre-bound inputs persisted with the flow version and copied into run state
open_points.default_guess: Inject all constants at run start, validating against target input schema then.

open_points.subject: Trial/admission handling of file outputs (M07, M21, A04)
open_points.text: M07 says TrialExecution `outputs` are "StoredValues by output port"; M21 says StoredValue `carriage` is "`value`, or `file` only for a trial case's file fixture"; A04 pass logic compares output value digests to expected outputs.
open_points.question: How are function file outputs represented in TrialExecution and compared in admission when expected outputs are present?
options: Allow StoredValue `file` for TrialExecution outputs too (expand M21 scope)
Represent trial file outputs separately as fixture-like artifacts and compare fixture digests
Disallow file outputs in contracts used for trial expected-output matching
open_points.default_guess: Allow StoredValue file records for TrialExecution outputs and compare digests the same way as value outputs.

open_points.subject: Manifest-mismatch reason vocabulary (A08/A09)
open_points.text: A08 rule 5 requires proposal refusal "naming the first failing check" and A09 rule 6 says pre-send `operation_failed` detail names the failing check, but no closed set of reason identifiers is defined.
open_points.question: What exact reason codes/text must be emitted for each failing check so behavior is deterministic across implementations?
options: Define a closed enum of reason codes mapped 1:1 to checks in A08/A09
Use free-text reason strings derived from check labels
open_points.default_guess: Define and use a closed enum of reason codes, one per listed check, in listed-order precedence.

open_points.subject: Case-insensitive duplicate required-header handling path (A09 rule 1 vs A08 rule 5/6)
open_points.text: A09 rule 1 says a manifest record naming one required header twice (case-insensitive) "is a manifest mismatch"; A08 rule 5 enumerates proposal-time mismatch checks and explicitly imports path-shape checks from A09 rule 1 but does not explicitly enumerate duplicate-header checks.
open_points.question: Must duplicate required-header names be rejected at binding proposal/acceptance time, only at send-time stale check, or both?
options: Reject at proposal and acceptance as manifest mismatch; at send-time treat as stale/no send
Allow proposal, fail only at send-time pre-send check
open_points.default_guess: Reject at proposal/acceptance and also fail send-time re-check as stale if manifest becomes invalid later.
